from flashtext import KeywordProcessor


def test_extracts_added_keyword():
    kp = KeywordProcessor()
    kp.add_keyword('Big Apple', 'New York')
    assert kp.extract_keywords('I love Big Apple.') == ['New York']


def test_no_keyword_gives_empty_list():
    kp = KeywordProcessor()
    kp.add_keyword('Big Apple')
    assert kp.extract_keywords('nothing here') == []
